Longevity Life Academy presents
The longevity masterclass of the year.

Learn directly from our founding faculty member Julie Gibson Clark, ranked the world's second-slowest ager in the 2023 Rejuvenation Olympics, ahead of Bryan Johnson.

A rare opportunity to experience Longevity Life Academy live: one focused, standalone 60-minute masterclass exploring Julie's personal longevity protocol, from nutrition and movement to sleep and daily habits.

Go beyond the headlines. Discover the routine behind her results and practical ideas to inform your own approach to healthy aging.

Masterclass admission: $49.
VIP experience: $79, including an additional private 30-minute Q&A with Julie.

Choose your live session on Zoom:
October 27, 2026 at 7 pm Eastern
November 14, 2026 at 1 pm Eastern

Limited live seats. Reserve your place with Longevity Life Academy by eTeacher Group.
